tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the AI video models VidFare tracks, with the cheapest current dollars per second for each.

tools.name: get_model_prices
tools.description: List current VidFare prices for one model. provider and resolution are optional filters. Prices the catalog does not contain are omitted rather than guessed.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Cost of one clip from the VidFare calculator. Credit-plan rows use plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip, then the percent of credits used. API rows are billed seconds times the stated dollars per second. A length, resolution, audio value, or input the vendor page does not state is returned withou

tools.name: cheapest_options
tools.description: Cheapest stated VidFare price for a clip length and resolution, overall and per model. Rows the vendor does not state for that length or resolution are omitted.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List VidFare deals copied from vendor pages and official accounts. status is live, upcoming, ended, or all. Defaults to live. An end date is included only when the source stated one.
